text.p: Shares in Hungarian oil company MOL surged more than eight percent in the first half hour of trading on the Budapest Stock Exchange on Wednesday catching up with its increasing price on London's SEAQ, traders said.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange MOL opened at 3,250 forints, up from Tuesday's close of 3,220 and at 1008 GMT it traded at 3,490.
In London MOL's Global Depositary Receipts GDRs) opened at $17.875 and gradually strengthened to $18.975, up from Tuesday's close of $17.4.
The price rally follows a pricing late on Tuesday of MOL shares in a six-times oversubscribed global offering at $16.25 or 2,970 forints.
Traders said the rally reflected investors' attempts to buy back MOL shares they had sold earlier and it also reflected expectations for good first quarter results.
